ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Superset uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Superset needs access to your photo library so you can attach images to chat messages.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Superset uses the camera so you can attach photos to chat messages.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Superset uses the microphone so you can dictate chat messages.
